fields.davesch\n\n 2020-10-15 21:57\n\ndevelope:
click the tag button
an alpha sorted list of tags appears (this is odd since Tags are priority sorted in the other dialogs and that isn't even an option)

I think the list being alphabetical is appropriate. Selecting a tag it is easier to scan an alphabetical list than a mixed list.

The Priority list list determines which order Tags are displayed and probably more importantly, the Color to display if more than one set tag has a color setting.

Tag icon labels

I propose a change to the List View Tag icon label from
"Tag selected rows"
to
"New, Organize, or Tag selected rows"

And a change to the Edit window's Tag icon label from
"Edit the tag list"
to
"Tag record from list"
fields.bamaustin\n\n 2020-10-16 03:52\n\ndevelo:
I strongly disagree that this is a 'Feature Request' instead of a Bug Report.

The tags list is short enough that the Ctrl/Cmd-F (search as you type) interface should be DISABLED for this GUI section. Adding the functionality adds code (& documentation) clutter without enough added value.

I noted the broken functionality but gave no resolution recommendation.

However, my personal opinion is that this search feature's broken interface should be removed from Tags, not repaired.
